title: Switch a board to 3D and save the view as a bitmap
summary: Shows how to run the built-in PCB:SwitchTo3D process, read the board's 3D view state, and capture the view window to a BMP file through its handle and bounds with Win32 GDI.
phrasings: take a screenshot of the PCB 3D view
switch the PCB editor to 3D mode from code
run a built-in process from an extension
save the board view as an image

commands.name: CreatePcb3DImage
commands.description: Switch the PCB view to 3D and save it as a bitmap
commands.params: Out=<file or folder> (optional, default: temp folder, file Pcb3DImage.bmp)
